title: AppVeil experimental register bytecode v1 (research prototype)
description: Structural schema for VM bytecode. The opcode table ships inside the artifact and is NOT secret. The VM additionally enforces the semantic constraints listed in x-appveil-semantic-constraints. Conformance to this schema is not a security property.
x-appveil-semantic-constraints: Instruction i (except the last) writes register i (SSA)
Operand registers reference only earlier registers
Exactly one ret, and it is the last instruction; its register is defined
Operand count matches the decoded operation: load-input 0, load-const 1 (uint32), not 1, binary ops 2
